scope: Fixtures and transformations for the separately labelled Profiles 4.1 variation replay (scripts/oasis_profile_replay.py). Nothing here alters the strict report, the production server, its policy defaults or its RNG. Each applied entry is named in the per-case report.

interop_wrapper_omission.rule: Drop only a leading single-item Interop Begin and a trailing single-item Interop End exchange. Interop anywhere else leaves the case unexecuted; the production server does not offer Interop.

CS-RNG-O-4.label: client operation policy without RNG Seed (38)
CS-RNG-O-4.basis: The trace expects RNG Seed to be refused with Permission Denied for a client not authorized to seed. The fixture narrows only the test client's operation list through the existing policy file; the server code and default policy are unchanged.

sequences.basis: SASED-M-3 locates the Secret Data registered by SASED-M-2 (its Object Group names SASED-M-2). The pair runs on one store and one client; SASED-M-3 is unexecuted unless SASED-M-2 passes.
TL-M-3 locates the key created by TL-M-2 by its Application Specific Information. The pair runs on one store and one client; TL-M-3 is unexecuted unless TL-M-2 passes.

non_traces.rule: XML files whose root element is not KMIP (Word export parts inside the 3.0 archive's .fld directory) are not message traces and are excluded by this rule.

1.1.explanation: The 1.1 profiles archive contains no traces; its test cases are the separately pinned 1.1 Test Cases Committee Note replayed by scripts/oasis_legacy.py (docs/specs/legacy-testcases.json).

1.2.explanation: The 1.2 profiles archive contains no traces; its test cases are the separately pinned 1.2 Test Cases Committee Note replayed by scripts/oasis_legacy.py (docs/specs/legacy-testcases.json).

enumeration_supplements.basis: KMIP 2.1 section 11.38: PKCS#11 Function enumerations are the 1-based offset of the function in CK_FUNCTION_LIST_3_0; section 11.39: PKCS#11 Return Codes are the CK_RV values. The registry has no named values for either, so only the names these traces use need a mapping. Used by the variation harness only.

attribute_rules.basis: Attribute names are those with an "Attribute" table in KMIP 1.0-3.0 (extracted from the pinned spec text) plus 2.x vendor Attribute, Object Class, NIST Key Type, Protection Storage Masks and the 3.0 certificate name attributes. Multi-instance attributes are those whose rules table says "Multiple instances permitted Yes" in 1.4/2.1. A response may add attributes (Profiles 4.1.1), but not non-attribute fields or second instances of single-instance attributes.

server_to_client_fixture.label: client endpoint configured for server-to-client Notify/Put (harness mTLS listener)
server_to_client_fixture.applies_to: cases whose expected Query response lists Notify or Put
server_to_client_fixture.basis: Profiles that require the server-to-client operations Notify and Put (for example the 2.1 Quantum Safe Server, section 5.16.2) can only be met by a deployment that configures a client endpoint; the server lists Notify/Put in Query only for principals with one. The harness listener answers each request with Success after strict TTLV decoding.
